claims.evidence: PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; lipoaspirates are human

Analysed material is cell conditioned medium (secretome) from cultured ADRC fractions (Methods); adipose tissue is only the cell source (lipoaspirates) and is stated in the report, not asserted as the organism part. PRIDE organismPart CL:0000034 is a cell type.
